name: Codiepress WooCommerce Conditional Shipping and Payments – Hide Shipping & Payment Methods
author: Repon Hossain

sections.description:
Looking for an easy way to restrict shipping methods or payment gateways in WooCommerce? The Conditional Shipping and Payments for WooCommerce plugin allows store owners to:

✔ Hide or enable specific shipping methods based on cart total, weight, quantity, shipping class, or product categories.
✔ Restrict payment gateways based on customer roles, billing country, products in the cart, or order history.
✔ Set custom shipping rules for different user types (wholesale, retail, or VIP customers).
✔ Disable cash on delivery (COD) or specific payment methods for certain locations.
✔ Control shipping options dynamically based on flexible rules.

This plugin is perfect for WooCommerce store owners who want to optimize the checkout experience by displaying only relevant shipping and payment options to customers.

Key Features

✅ Hide WooCommerce shipping methods based on:
– Cart total, weight, or quantity
– Specific products or product categories
– Customer roles and user meta
– Shipping and billing address
– Date and time (e.g., restrict methods on weekends)

✅ Restrict WooCommerce payment gateways dynamically:
– Disable payment methods for specific users or roles
– Hide certain payment gateways for high or low cart totals
– Restrict gateways based on country, state, or zip code
– Block payments for specific coupons or discounts

✅ Advanced Conditional Rules
– Use multiple conditions together
– Works with WooCommerce shipping zones & shipping classes
– Compatible with all major WooCommerce payment gateways

Why Use Conditional Shipping & Payments for WooCommerce?

🚀 Enhance customer checkout experience – Show only relevant shipping & payment methods.
🛒 Improve conversion rates – Avoid abandoned carts by offering the right options.
🔄 Flexible & easy-to-use – No coding required!

Installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install the plugin via WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Add conditions for hiding or showing shipping and payment methods based on cart rules.

sections.faq:
Q: Can I hide shipping methods based on the cart total?

A: Yes, you can disable specific shipping methods if the cart total is above or below a set value.

Q: Can I restrict PayPal or Cash on Delivery (COD) for certain users?

A: Yes, you can disable payment methods based on customer roles, billing country, or cart conditions.

Q: Does this work with WooCommerce shipping zones?

A: Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce shipping zones and classes.

Q: Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce multi-vendor plugins?

A: Yes, it works with most multi-vendor plugins like Dokan and WCFM.

Q: How do I set up conditional payment methods?

A: Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and add conditional rules for restricting payment gateways.
